text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I visit the track, I find Symboli
Rudolf
speaking to a group of students,
but the
atmosphere is strangely tense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If you've seen the notice, then you'll know why you're here—you each have repeated instances of truancy from extra classes. As such, this is an additional extra class.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However... that you've chosen to come
at all
indicates that some semblance of
passion towards
racing remains in you.
That is what I'm choosing
to believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
For as long as you have the will, I shall
do my best
to help you reach your full
potential. And it's for
that purpose that
I've summoned a very special
coach
today.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: ...Eep! K-Kris S?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Let's begin.

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. ...A little late, don't ya think?
The
academy probably has me down as a
total
write-off at this point!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I cannot yet ascertain the merits of any
of you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Pair running. That's how I'll measure
your
capabilities.

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Gasp! Wheeze! Dammit!

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it. There's just no way a loser
like me can
measure up to an elite
runner like you...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
You gave every ounce of strength you
had... and
hung on till the very end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A failure... would not have done that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Stand up. I know where you need to
improve.
Your lesson begins now...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...That's all. Remember to keep your
center of
gravity close to the ground...
at all times. Now...
go. Apply what
you've learned.

text_block_list.name: Slovenly Student
text_block_list.text:
Nothing changed even after my regular
teacher fixed my
form up. As if a few
pointers from this "coach" will do

anything...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I will say it again. Go. Apply what
you've
learned.

text_block_list.name: Slovenly Student
text_block_list.text: Eek! O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Good.

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Well, look at you, being
patient with us
good-for-nothings! You
want a pat on the back or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No. And I disagree... with your
assessment of
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Either way... I will make you all as strong
as you
can be. That is... my duty.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My deepest gratitude to you, Kris S.
Thanks to
your coaching, everyone here
looks like an
entirely different person
from when we began.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I simply... fulfilled my duty. And I am
indebted
myself... to the Symboli family.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You've been a real help. All these
students were
positively bursting with
enthusiasm when they
first enrolled, you
see. I felt I had to intervene
somehow.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And I had no doubt that you, if no one
else,
would be able to offer them some
heartfelt
coaching.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...My mission is complete. ...Goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: It's over! ...Th-that was terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The students hurry away as if trying to
escape
Symboli Kris S. One student stays
behind,
however, and approaches her
temporary coach.

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text: Um! ...Kris S!

text_block_list.name: Troublemaking Student
text_block_list.text:
Uh... I just wanted to say... thank you!
For today!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: You don't need to thank me. As I said...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I fulfilled my duty... that is all.
